subject: Finovate: request for SOC 2 incident summary + telemetry extract
messages:
From: Alicia Park <alicia.park@finovate.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Finovate Security Team <security@finovate.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SOC 2 incident summary + telemetry extract

Hi Karthik,

We detected unexpected elevated error rates for API keys that integrate with your hosted endpoint between 2026-11-17 02:10 UTC and 2026-11-17 02:24 UTC. Our security team would like a short SOC 2-style incident summary (timeline, impact, containment) and an extract of relevant telemetry (request IDs, truncated request bodies, auth tokens redacted) to support our internal audit.

Could you share:
- A one-page incident summary suitable for our SOC 2 evidence binder (PDF).
- A machine-readable telemetry extract CSV with columns: timestamp, request_id, route, status_code, user_agent (PII redacted).
- A checklist of the IR steps you followed and the current containment status.

We need these items by EOD PST tomorrow (2026-11-19) to meet our audit timeline. If you need narrower scoping (IP ranges / tenant IDs), let me know — happy to provide.

Attachment: request-form.pdf (PDF) — simple intake form.

Thanks,
Alicia Park
Senior Security Analyst
Finovate
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Park <alicia.park@finovate.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 incident summary + telemetry extract

Alicia — thanks for the heads up and the intake form. We can provide what you need. Quick clarification so we scope precisely:

1) Do you want the full 14-minute window you called out, or only traces that resulted in 5xx status codes?
2) Should we include traces where the client IP is in your allowlist (you may want those excluded)?

Planned next steps (high level):
- We will produce a one-page summary targeted at SOC 2 (timeline, root cause hypothesis, mitigations).
- Telemetry extract: CSV exported from our logging index with PII redaction; we will include request_id and route.
- Attach our IR runbook excerpt showing containment steps taken.

Timeline: aiming to get the one-pager + telemetry extract initial drop by 2026-11-19 16:00 PST. If you confirm scope now, we'll proceed.

Attachment: IRP-summary-v2.pdf (excerpt) — contains runbook steps and containment checklist.

Karthik Iyer
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Alicia Park <alicia.park@finovate.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Finovate Security Team <security@finovate.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 incident summary + telemetry extract

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the quick reply. Please scope the export to:
- Full 2026-11-17 02:00:00 UTC to 2026-11-17 02:30:00 UTC window (we want some buffer).
- Include all status codes but flag rows with status >= 500.
- Exclude requests where client_ip is in our allowlist: 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.128/25.

Also please upload the artifacts to the secure upload link in your SFTP or the temporary share we provided at https://files.redwood.com/uploads/finovate/secure-upload-link. We will confirm receipt via HubSpot ticket FTV-5821.

DocuSign: Our procurement team requires a short NDA amendment for audit artifacts — here is the DocuSign link (expires in 7 days): https://docusign.com/link/finovate-nondisclosure/FTV-5821.

If anything blocks delivery by your target time, let us know; we may accept a partial CSV first.

—Alicia
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Park <alicia.park@finovate.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 incident summary + telemetry extract

Alicia — following up with the delivery items and next steps. Apologies for the brief delay; we wanted to ensure redaction and sampling are correct before upload.

What we've delivered to the secure upload link:
- postmortem-draft.pdf (one-page summary): timeline, root cause (misrouted cache invalidation leading to spike in backend timeouts for route /v1/generate), containment actions taken at 02:26 UTC, and mitigation plan.
- telemetry-extract.csv (machine-readable): columns = timestamp, request_id, route, status_code, user_agent (PII redacted), client_ip (CIDR-masked). We flagged rows with status >= 500 in the last column.
- telemetry-extract-instructions.txt: notes on how the CSV was generated and redaction steps (hashing and IP masking).

Attachments included in the upload: postmortem-draft.pdf (pdf), telemetry-extract.csv (csv), telemetry-extract-instructions.txt (txt).

Notes / caveats:
- We removed full request bodies; sample truncated bodies are provided where needed for reproduction.
- Token/auth data is redacted; we can provide hashed tokens under an executed NDA amendment only.

Next steps: once you confirm receipt we will:
1) Finalize postmortem and sign it off internally (target 2026-11-22).
2) If you need hashed tokens or additional logs, we will connect via your secure DocuSign link to add the NDA amendment and then transfer artifacts.

Let us know if the CSV format is acceptable or if you need a different column set.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
